messages:
tom_sales: Quick sync 1: NeonWorks POC ready. Procurement says invoice must be issued by Redwood Inference EU GmbH but the MSA on file names Redwood US Inc. They want a single signature on the OF. Can we avoid re-executing the MSA? @leah_legal @omar_finance

leah_legal: Short answer: yes via a 1-page billing linkage addendum. Will link OF to existing MSA, name Redwood EU as billing party for OF only, and include an "electronic signatures binding" clause. Need NeonWorks KYC and confirmation of entity names exactly as on bank account.

omar_finance: Finance: EU billing OK if invoices go to EU account, include VAT reg no, and are in EUR. Treasury needs IBAN/SWIFT and PO number. For POC SLA credit, cap at 10% of POC fee. Net30 standard unless procurement insists otherwise. Need executed docs by Thu 15:00 CET for month-end processing.

mei_solutions: Delivery: POC uses masked production telemetry; ops can host in EU region to satisfy DPA. If they request HIPAA BAAs, that'll need a bit more time. Otherwise DPA v2 with EU controller language will work.

tom_sales: They provided PO NW-77, VAT ES33445566, want invoice to "Redwood Inference EU GmbH", EUR, net30. KYC attached. Timeline: need signed OF + addendum by Wed. I'll route for e-sign once legal posts redline.

leah_legal: I'll draft addendum now (billing party, link to MSA date, limited cross-entity indemnity for POC, SLA clause as discussed). Circulating redline in #legal-drafts in 20m. ops to prepare DocuSign envelope with explicit entity lines.

esign-bot: esign-bot: Recommended envelope: OF + Billing Linkage Addendum + DPA v2. Single envelope, Customer signs first, Redwood EU signer second. Template: /ops/templates/billing-linkage-eu-v1.docx. Audit trail enabled.

omar_finance: Once signed, treasury will issue invoice and schedule collection. Please ensure PO number on invoice and include VAT. I'll pre-create a draft invoice tentatively.

tom_sales: Thanks all 10: routing now to NeonWorks for e-sign. Will update on signature.
